name: White Soft Paraffin
mechanism: Occlusive emollient - reduces transepidermal water loss
monitoring: Assess skin hydration and tolerability; check for signs of folliculitis if occlusive use is extensive
pregnancy: Considered safe for topical use in pregnancy
sideEffects: Greasy residue, staining of clothing, potential fire hazard if fabrics are heavily contaminated with product
pharmacokinetics: Acts topically as an occlusive barrier with minimal systemic absorption
clinicalPearls: Highly occlusive and effective for severe dry skin; often combined with liquid paraffin; warn patients about fire risk and clothing staining
indication: Dry skin, eczema, psoriasis, ichthyosis and related conditions
